Hjordis the Sarl

Among the women of the Sarl, Hjordis was difficult to overlook. Tall and lithe, with golden hair falling in long coils and bright azure eyes, she possessed the beauty celebrated by skalds in countless northern sagas. Yet appearances tell only half a tale in Norsca. Hjordis was no timid hall-maiden content to avert her eyes before warriors and kings. Even when confronted by the fury of Wulfrik himself, she remained steadfast enough to meet his gaze. Such courage is not easily forgotten amongst a people who prize strength above comfort. Beneath the wolfskin and golden hair lies the same stubborn spirit that has carried generations of Sarl warriors across the Sea of Claws.
